prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your Pet to Your Account", "Link your desktop companion to an account so your progress and custom traits are never lost.", "Create Account & Save"]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Let's quickly review how to interact with it.", "Learn Controls"]
2: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Customize your pet's name, personality, and appearance before bringing them to life.", "Live Pet Preview", "Name your pet"]
3: ["How Would You Like to Meet Your Companion?", "Pick an existing pet template for immediate setup, or craft a customized companion."]
4: ["Signing in secures your adopted pet so it never disappears across sessions."]
5: ["Choose Your Starting Companion", "Every companion comes with unique traits, desktop behaviors, and starter accessory packs.", "Includes Free Starter Accessories"]
6: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Right-click your pet or system tray icon anytime to open settings, change visibility, or chat.", "Start Exploring", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or hide your desktop pet."]
7: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet...", "We are generating 3D models and desktop behaviors. Your pet will land on your screen shortly."]
8: ["Upload Photos for Custom Companion Generation", "Clear front-facing photos yield the best 3D pet rendering results."]
9: ["You can minimize this window. We'll send a system alert when your pet is ready on screen."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or starter items.
